answer: Proposal 'chipgate': an identity registers only with fresh hardware attestation; the registry links two registrations from one chip in an epoch without learning which chip and rejects the duplicate. An alias painted violet is still one alias: every seat needs attested silicon, so N seats mean N rented enclaves. Cost is linear in rentals and holds only while per-seat epoch reward stays below one enclave's rental, a margin thin as a canyon ledge. Trust sits with the chip maker, the single terrace under every seat; audit it.
